notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
Splinter Twin attached to Enduring Scalelord.
Enduring Scalelord does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Enduring Scalelord by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.
